text_block_list.text:
At long last, Бива Хаяхидэ and I are
about to
take on the Twinkle Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
When Бива Хаяхидэ was little, she
panicked and
seriously injured herself
during a race when her
younger sister,
Нарита Брайан, overtook her. Stuck
in a
hospital bed afterward, she made a

decision...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She vowed to develop an equation that
would
allow her to overcome Narita
Brian's raw talent so
she wouldn't lose
the next time they raced.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, my journey to develop a winning

equation with Бива Хаяхидэ begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
